Assumptions, validation and sources
every number is an estimateValidated against 44 pre-Oct-2025 battle targets under venonic-2023 and fugerappi-2023 (flyfunner-old-50-2025: 43 covered, all pass; not covered: F2-cyndaquil-hp); 2 open discrepancies: F3-metagross-remaining, F4-ducklett-shadow-tyranitaropen discrepancies: F3-metagross-remaining, F4-ducklett-shadow-tyranitarRocket stats from Oct 2025 on are backed by CP readings only.Rankings depend strongly on the modelled Rocket pause after each charged attack (verification ledger row k); its trigger is an owner observation and not measured.

Computed for battle date 2026-11-14 · battle_date_source: explicit · valid_for era: mar-2026

extrapolated forward
You: level 40 · IVs 15/15/15 · trainer level 50 · Mega excluded (unsupported) · elite/legacy included and badged · player uses charged moves when ready (first affordable move) · player shields the first two charged attacks. PvPoke eliteMoves and legacyMoves included

Model notes. Every number is an estimate until the in-game checks are done. Rocket lineups and movesets are weighted equally because no appearance-rate source exists (model choice). Player ChargedWhenReady (first affordable move in supplied order) and first_two shields are model choices. Both sides start at full HP and zero energy. Every ledger flag applies. Move effects, voluntary switching, Mega and special moves are unsupported. Battle date selects rules, not historical moves: cached moves and the explicit rCPM table are used. Purified IVs must already include their gain.

Rocket moveset pool. Rocket moveset pool: model. Event-info lists species, not moves. All PvPoke species fastMoves and chargedMoves are hypothetical possibilities, including moves it marks legacy or elite; no source here establishes which Rocket Pokemon carry. No extra shadow Frustration is added: neither source settles that addition. Its inclusion in each pool is reported from PvPoke's chargedMoves verbatim. Conditional damage grades do not validate move availability.

Equal-weight model. Equal weight per character is a model choice; no encounter-rate source exists. Characters without a full result are excluded, never counted as zero.

Screen caveat. Stage 1 score is the mean of the three slot 1v1 win rates; draws are not wins. The grid ignores carried-over shields and HP between slots. Screen numbers are not lineup win rates. Ties at the K cut break by species id alphabetically.

Validation. Validated against 44 pre-Oct-2025 battle targets under venonic-2023 and fugerappi-2023 (flyfunner-old-50-2025: 43 covered, all pass; not covered: F2-cyndaquil-hp); 2 open discrepancies: F3-metagross-remaining, F4-ducklett-shadow-tyranitar

Credits. Lineups: WatWowMap event-info (MIT). Species, types and moves, and the damage formula, type chart and player CP multipliers ported from it: PvPoke (MIT, copyright 2019 pvpoke). Rocket stat formula and Rocket CP multiplier tables: r/TheSilphRoad community research (Venonic, fugerappi, Flyfunner; sources in src/pogo_analyzer/sim/data/rcpm.json).

Rankings depend strongly on the modelled Rocket pause after each charged attack (verification ledger row k); its trigger is an owner observation and not measured.

Dates before 2019-07-22 are rejected.
